Tom (Customer): Hey team — hitting an odd issue with JSON mode on our invoice endpoint. We're seeing numeric fields come back as strings ~10% of the time. Breaking production today :grimacing:
Priya (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a tiny request+response example? Is this only on hosted or also on Dedicated/private?
Tom (Customer): Minimal repro below. Using hosted API, mode=\"json\" with schema expecting amount:number and paid:boolean. Occasionally response has \"amount\": \"1200\" and \"paid\": \"false\" (strings).
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "mode": "json", "schema": { "amount": "number", "paid": "boolean" }, "prompt": "invoice" }
---
200 OK
{ "amount": "1200", "paid": "false" }
```
Gabe (Eng): Thanks. Do you see any pattern? model version, short vs long prompts, or when KV cache is warmed?
Tom (Customer): No clear pattern. Seems more common under heavier load and after an auth token rotation we did yesterday. Also noticed latency spikes at same time.
Olivia (SRE): Could be a routing/fallback event where a cheaper model variant (quantized) handled some requests. Those variants sometimes stringify small ints in our current parser path. Can you share request_id from one of the failed responses?
Tom (Customer): request_id: r-0a9f3c6b, attached full response and headers.
Priya (Support): Got it, filing an internal ticket. deploy-bot: Created INC-4739 for Tom (Customer) referencing r-0a9f3c6b :white_check_mark:
Gabe (Eng): Reproduced locally with a stress test. When token was rotated mid-run our routing layer temporarily sent a subset of traffic to a fallback model family that returns stringified primitives for speed. Parser expected native types and did not coerce.
Gabe (Eng): Quick mitigation: set structured_output_tolerance: \"coerce_primitives\" on the request to coerce numeric-looking strings into numbers, or pin model version to the verified variant. Example header: `X-Redwood-Structured-Tolerance: coerce_primitives`
Tom (Customer): That workaround helps. Any root fix ETA? We can't keep pinning versions.
Gabe (Eng): Engineering plan: 1) Fix parser to accept numeric strings when schema says number and convert server-side (low-risk hotfix). 2) Long-term: tighten routing so fallback variants advertise their output typing guarantees. Hotfix target: ~24-48hrs.
Olivia (SRE): Also rolling back the token rotation routing rule to avoid mid-rotation fallthroughs. That should reduce incidents.
Priya (Support): I'll keep you posted and provide a safe curl snippet to coerce until hotfix is live. :thumbsup:
Tom (Customer): Thanks all. Please cc me on INC-4739 for status.
Priya (Support): CC'd and will update the ticket when hotfix is staged.
Gabe (Eng): Logged a regression test in CI to simulate token-rotation routing and verify structured output types.
Tom (Customer): Appreciate it — solution accepted for now.
